text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: The Yasuda Kinen is 1,600 meters long. It's just barely within the limit of what I can run. On top of that, I'm up against Taiki, and the track is heavy…

text_block_list.name: Seeking the Pearl
text_block_list.text: Conditions are looking bleak, but if I run well despite all these disadvantages, I'm sure everyone will see my strength for what it really is!
